questions.stemHtml: A 45-year-old male patient presents with dyspnea on exertion and occasional palpitations. A chest X-ray is performed, revealing the cardiac silhouette. Study the image provided and answer the following question. Which of the following statements regarding the heart's position, size, and borders on the chest radiograph is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: The right heart border is formed primarily by the right ventricle.

options.label: B
options.text: The left atrium primarily forms the left heart border.

options.label: C
options.text: The cardiothoracic ratio (CTR) is considered normal if it is less than 0.5 on a PA chest X-ray.

options.label: D
options.text: The right atrium and the left ventricle mainly form the inferior border of the heart.
